description: Project manifest defining scripts, dependencies, and metadata for the Deltaflow React/Vite app.
Exact dependency graph generated by npm to ensure reproducible installs in every environment.
Primary TypeScript compiler options for the browser codebase (strict flags, module resolution, path aliases).
TS config used for Node-targeted files such as Vite config and build tooling.
Runtime metadata describing the app name, description, and permission prompts for hosted deployments.
Legacy shared TypeScript interfaces for ADONIS models used by the non-src build.
Vite build/dev configuration with React plugin setup, env injection, and proxy definitions for APIs.
Ambient declaration so TypeScript understands the shape of the Vite config export.
Legacy single-view React app that lists ADONIS models and offers an optimization panel.
Legacy ReactDOM bootstrapper that mounts the older App.tsx implementation.
Legacy BPMN viewer component that renders XML via the global bpmn-js instance.
Legacy sidebar tree for browsing ADONIS model groups in the older UI.
Legacy SVG icon set shared by the non-src components.
Legacy helper that signs ADONIS REST calls via Web Crypto generated headers.
Legacy data service that reads ADONIS repositories via the /proxy endpoint.
Legacy Google Gemini integration used by the earlier UI to optimize BPMN XML.
Current React entry file that wraps App with the ErrorBoundary and mounts it with ReactDOM.
Main application shell orchestrating repository browsing, AI optimization/creation flows, and UI state.
Modern BPMN viewer hooking into the CDN bpmn-js instance and fitting diagrams to the viewport.
Resizable navigation sidebar that lists groups/models and surfaces creation actions.
Central React SVG icon library (including the animated loader) used throughout the new UI.
Modal dialog that lets users enter or override ADONIS/API credentials stored in localStorage.
Top-level React error boundary that catches render failures and shows a fallback message.
Stateful hook that loads ADONIS groups/models, tracks expansions, and fetches diagram XML on selection.
Reusable hook to call an AI provider for process creation, manage loading states, and cycle status messages.
Hook that runs AI optimizations on existing BPMN, tracks streaming messages, and records duration metrics.
Utility hook that cycles through an array of status messages at a fixed interval.
Wraps the Web Speech API to toggle dictation, normalize punctuation, and feed transcripts into prompts.
Generates signed ADONIS REST headers (HMAC) that can be reused by every frontend fetch call.
Primary ADONIS API client fetching group contents and BPMN XML through the proxy-aware origin resolver.
Handles cleaning XML and posting optimized/created BPMN diagrams back into ADONIS repositories.
Shared helper that decides whether to call ADONIS directly or via /proxy based on env flags.
Google Gemini client plus XML post-processing utilities for optimize/create/transcript flows.
OpenAI Responses API wrapper that mirrors the Gemini workflows when the user selects OpenAI.
Anthropic Claude integration exposing the same create/optimize/transcript helpers.
Canonical TypeScript interfaces covering ADONIS groups/models and API response shapes for the modern app.
Reads env vars and localStorage overrides so runtime config can be edited without rebuilds.
BPMN XML helpers that sanitize, strip extensions, condense whitespace, and maintain DI before uploads.
Parses uploaded transcript files (VTT/CSV/TXT) into normalized text fed into AI creation.
Custom env/type augmentations exposing Vite variables, speech recognition interfaces, and process.env typings.
